name: SLC Collider Hall (SLD)
notes: No official SLAC page or the SLD detector paper was fetched with a coordinate specific to this hall in this session; the general SLAC campus point is reused here with a note, per A17.

summary.plain: The experimental hall at SLAC where the SLD detector recorded collisions from the SLC collider.
summary.technical: SLC collider interaction hall, SLAC campus, housing the SLD (SLAC Large Detector) (1989-1998); no coordinate distinct from the general SLAC campus point was found in this session (see note).
